task: Asha wants to add two marks values, 12 and 3. The code prints 123 instead of 15. Which mistake is this?

options.text: A decimal point makes a decimal
options.why: There is no decimal point anywhere in this code.
The printed value is not the problem; the values were stored as text.

options.text: A number and text cannot be added
options.why: Both values are text, so nothing is mixed and there is no error.

ok: Both values are in quotes, so they are text, and + joins text: 123.
